name: Barbell Bradford Press
steps: Stand tall with a barbell resting across your front shoulders, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, and feet hip-width apart.
Brace your abs and glutes tightly to keep your torso steady.
Press the bar just high enough to clear the crown of your head and lower it smoothly behind your head to ear level.
Press immediately back up over your head and lower the bar smoothly to your front shoulders to complete one repetition.
tips: Keep your head still and neutral rather than ducking forward as the bar passes.
Use a moderate weight and keep constant shoulder tension without locking out at the top.
